question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH order_rows AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id, 
        customer_id, 
        pizza_id, 
        exclusions, 
        extras, 
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, ROWID) as row_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.pizza_id,
        TRIM(t.value) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_recipes pr
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SPLIT(pr.toppings, ',')) AS t(value)
),
excluded_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        or2.row_id,
        TRIM(t.value) as topping_id
    FROM order_rows or2
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SPLIT(or2.exclusions, ',')) AS t(value)
    WHERE or2.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND or2.exclusions != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        or2.row_id,
        TRIM(t.value) as topping_id
    FROM order_rows or2
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SPLIT(or2.extras, ',')) AS t(value)
    WHERE or2.extras IS NOT NULL AND or2.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        or2.row_id,
        or2.order_id,
        or2.customer_id,
        or2.pizza_id,
        or2.order_time,
        st.topping_id,
        'standard' as source
    FROM order_rows or2
    JOIN standard_toppings st ON or2.pizza_id = st.pizza_id
    LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON st.topping_id = et.topping_id AND et.row_id = or2.row_id
    WHERE et.topping_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        or2.row_id,
        or2.order_id,
        or2.customer_id,
        or2.pizza_id,
        or2.order_time,
        et2.topping_id,
        'extra' as source
    FROM order_rows or2
    JOIN extra_toppings et2 ON et2.row_id = or2.row_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        order_time,
        topping_id,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_id
),
topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.row_id,
        tc.order_id,
        tc.customer_id,
        tc.pizza_id,
        tc.order_time,
        pt.topping_name,
        tc.cnt,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || pt.topping_name ELSE pt.topping_name END as formatted_name,
        CASE WHEN tc.cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_priority
    FROM topping_counts tc
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON tc.topping_id = pt.topping_id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        order_time,
        STRING_AGG(formatted_name, ', ' ORDER BY sort_priority, formatted_name) as ingredients
    FROM topping_names
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
)
SELECT 
    a.row_id,
    a.order_id,
    a.customer_id,
    pn.pizza_name || ': ' || a.ingredients as ingredients
FROM agg a
JOIN pizza_names pn ON a.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
ORDER BY a.row_id
